summary: Annaly Capital Management filed an 8-K announcing the full redemption of its 6.750% Series I Fixed-to-Floating Rate Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock. All 17,700,000 outstanding shares will be redeemed at $25.00 per share on October 1, 2026. Accrued dividends through September 30, 2026 will have been paid, leaving no unpaid dividends at redemption. The press release was furnished under Item 7.01, with the redemption detailed under Item 8.01. This return of capital reduces preferred equity and future dividend obligations. Watch for potential subsequent redemptions of other preferred series or impacts on capital structure and leverage ratios.
